summary: Focused frontend retest of 3 fixes from iteration_129, logged in as jacopo@schiantarelli.it (tenant c5ae2d0e). All 3 requested fixes work. While testing I found a new HIGH bug: the 'Modifica trattativa' dialog never loads the saved trattativa's data and always shows a blank form. (1) Server-side client search works: 'EMMECI LOGISTICA' returns 'EMMECI LOGISTICA SRL' and it can be selected; 'ROSSI' returns 24 matches across ragione_sociale/cognome/nome/email. (2) Kanban drag-move: after dragging TEST_A (premio 1000) from aperta to vinta, col-valore-aperta went from €1000 to €0, col-valore-vinta from €0 to €1000, riepilogo aperte from €1500,00 to €500,00 and vinte from €0,00 to €1000,00, all without a page reload (POST move, then GET /pipeline/trattative). The second drag (B, 500) from proposta_inviata to persa updated correctly as well. (3) Send confirmation: clicking tr-invia-email showed the confirm 'Inviare il preventivo via EMAIL a silvia.gaiani@maganetti.com?'. Cancelling it sent no POST to /invia. Clicking tr-invia-whatsapp on a client with no cellulare showed the error toast "Nessun numero cellulare sull'anagrafica" and sent nothing. No real email or WhatsApp was sent.

ui_bugs.issue: The edit form is never filled with the existing trattativa. After opening tr-edit-{id} on a fresh page, titolo is empty, cliente shows 'Seleziona cliente', premio_proposto is 0 and stato is 'Aperta', even though the record is 'TEST_Trattativa A', EMMECI, 1000 and 'vinta'. Cause: <TrattativaDialog editing={editing}/> stays mounted inside <Dialog> (only DialogContent unmounts), so useState(editing || blank) is set once on first render (editing=null) and never re-syncs. The form also keeps leftover values from the previous dialog: a client picked in 'Nuova trattativa' showed up in the next 'Modifica' form. Data-loss risk: if a user fills in titolo and cliente and saves, the PUT overwrites premio, stato, note, etc. with blank or default values.

issues: At 1920px the 5th column 'Perse' is cut off at the right edge and needs horizontal scrolling
Inconsistent currency formatting: the riepilogo shows '€ 1500,00' while column totals show '€ 1000' with no decimals or thousands separator

action_items: HIGH: Fix the TrattativaDialog edit form so it loads the selected trattativa. Either render <TrattativaDialog key={editing?.id || 'new'} ... /> or add useEffect(() => { setF(editing || BLANK); setClienteSearch(''); }, [editing]). Then check that the edit form shows titolo, cliente, premio and stato, and that saving does not wipe any fields.
critical_code_review_comments: Trattative.jsx: useState(editing || {...}) inside a component that stays mounted is a stale-state bug (see above).

Trattative.jsx invia(): the recipient comes from editing.anagrafica_email/anagrafica_cellulare; the backend should pick the same field so the address shown in the confirm matches the one actually used.
